\## Description



This PR establishes the initial repository structure, a GitHub Actions workflow for Python linting and testing, and a pull-request template. Python is used for the initial CI setup because the SRS identifies Django/Python as the backend technology; Node.js-related checks can be added when that service is introduced.



\## Related issue



Closes #23
